# Klangschrift Desktop Model Catalog — AP03 attribution register

This register describes source pins only. It does not install a runtime, ship a
model, or grant redistribution rights. AP07 must copy the complete applicable
license texts into the audited package and re-check the selected native archive.

- FluidAudio 0.17.5, FluidInference, Apache-2.0; local reference vendor revision
  `0b1f46289fe27d95b5e66ad8be46e64f5ee02ae7`.
- Phonon-2, Fermion Research, CC-BY-4.0 weights; the Core ML port is attributed
  to FluidInference. Windows CPU feasibility is deferred to AP09.
- Parakeet v3 / Redux Core ML ports, FluidInference; model weights attributed to
  NVIDIA/FluidInference under the reference's CC-BY-4.0 notice.
- Moonshine Voice 0.1.5 and the thirteen streaming models, Moonshine AI / Useful
  Sensors, MIT; source revision `234f60faa0eb388b01cdf7e60aca232af37aefda`.
- WhisperKit 1.1.0, Argmax, MIT; SDK commit
  `1e2a163736dfa5a198e637ae44c114e1c6d5cc2d`. Whisper Tiny/Base are OpenAI MIT.
- Sherpa-ONNX 1.13.8 and Zipformer EN INT8, k2-fsa / csukuangfj, Apache-2.0;
  ONNX Runtime is MIT and Kaldi Native Fbank is Apache-2.0.

The existing MLX Large-v3 and Turbo profiles are outside this module and remain
unchanged. This desktop catalog's own data-port revision is
`desktop-model-catalog-ap03-20261006`.
